text:
jordan: quick heads-up — cutting hotfix for kv-cache mem leak at 18:40 PST. PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1987 needs 2x approvals by t-minus 15m or our autobackout policy will block the merge. can anyone give fast eyes? :alarm_clock:

maria: on it, pinging @ryan and @sam. :eyes:

ryan: I'll do a rapid pass now. is there a specific smoke checklist i should run?

jordan: mostly mem use under long-lived connections and kv warmup. if you can run the small smoke suite (stability + kv-warm) that'll cover it. thanks.

qa-jen: kicking off sandbox smoke. will paste any red flags. ETA ~4m.

deploy-bot: smoke-run job #4421 started (sandbox). logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4421

qa-jen: smoke results: kv-warm ✅, stability ✅, one unrelated flaky trace in telemetry ingestion (ignoring). logs:
```
RequestId=abcd1234 TRACE: intermittent 502 on telemetry proxy (retry succeeded)
```

ryan: scanned the diff, small naming nit in the helper but not blocking. leaving a tiny comment, will approve after update. grabbing LGTM shortly. :eyeglasses:

ryan: LGTM — responded to the nit with a one-line fix and re-ran unit tests (all green).

sam: saw the smoke results, looks safe to me. doing merge-signoff. LGTM :thumbsup:

maria: adding second approver now — thanks @ryan @sam. merging once CI finishes.

jordan: reminder: if CI or approvals miss cutoff, autobackout will prevent the rollout and we'll need to reschedule the window. happy to wait 5m for CI to finish.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #1987. Merge allowed.

maria: merged and pushed. git ref: `main@{2023-11-14T18:41:00Z}`. starting canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started at 18:45 PST — monitoring hooks enabled.

jordan: excellent — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. closing thread. :rocket:
